claims.quote: The PRRT2 gene is the first identified causative gene and accounts for the majority of PKD.

claims.object_text: aberrant splicing (exon skipping and intron retention)
claims.quote: Functional assays showed that 11 PRRT2 variants, including missense and intronic variants, caused aberrant splicing events, such as exon skipping and intron retention.
a minigene system carrying these variants was constructed and introduced into HEK293T cells for functional assays to assess the pathogenicity.
These variants comprised 10 intronic variants, two synonymous variants, one deletion, and one missense variant.
five patients with PRRT2 variants previously classified as variants of uncertain significance can now be genetically diagnosed with PKD or other PRRT2-related disorders.
In silico predictions suggested that all variants, except for one deep intronic variant, had the potential to affect normal splicing.
